'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Vikram Bali LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Username:''' DVD ROTS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
